text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm Fine Motion. And it's a fine pleasure
to meet
you, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What I'm hoping for... is to make a grand
heap of
wonderful memories with
everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm to race with all I've got!
It'd be just smashing if we could make
these next three years
together a time to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
